Marathi Film 'Gondhal' Eligible for Oscars 2027

The Marathi film 'Gondhal' has become eligible for consideration in the International Feature Film category at the 99th Academy Awards in 2027. It is among a total of 104 films on the eligibility list for this category. The film 'Angh' is also mentioned as being on the list. The coverage also notes that 38 animated films and 190 documentaries are in contention for their respective categories.
